object: PR 2542's claim 'No 17-point set covers F2^7' (README, 'Why length 18 collapses', item 3), audited against its own lemma table at the set level
result_summary: (9,8)/(8,9) dead in the identity (PR 2542's own rows, re-derived); (10,7)/(7,10) EXCLUDED (no surviving sharp row after the min-excess census); (11,6)/(6,11) reduced to two rows (5,1),(6,0) - the (3,3) and (4,2) rows are demoted by the completed k=11 census (zero 11-sets of excess <= 4). The literal claim is established for four of the six counting-feasible splits; the two (11,6)/(6,11) rows remain open.

identity_rows.constraint: odd excess sum_o (r_o - 1) = s*t - 64; colliding cross pairs sum_o C(r_o, 2) = 2 * sum_x A_x B_x = 2c; C(r,2) >= r-1 per mask; profiles partition the excess into j = r_o - 1 parts with sigma = sum j(j+1)/2 = 2c even

min_excess_census.group: E = even-weight elements of F2^7, isomorphic to F2^6; GL(6,2)-invariant (extension to the odd coset preserves pair sums, cross sums and coverage); shard {0, 3} is existence-complete by transitivity
min_excess_census.k11_budget4_walk: complete: 62/62 sub-shards, level-3 count 0, level-4 count 0 (zero 11-sets of pair-sum excess <= 4; RAW11-PROGRESS.json, resumable per sub-shard)
consequences: min pair-sum excess of 10-point sets in F2^6 is exactly 3 (10-sets of excess <= 2 do not exist; the floor is attained 149,990,400 times through {0,3})
min pair-sum excess of 11-point sets in F2^6 is >= 5 (the completed budget-4 walk finds zero leaves in every sub-shard)
the extremal (10,7) row (e_ex = 0) is impossible (F2^6 has no Sidon 10-set)
every surviving (10,7) row needs shared = 3 - e_ex - b_ex <= 0, and the only such row (3,0) attains c = 0 only: the (10,7)/(7,10) splits are excluded
the surviving (11,6) rows are (5,1),(6,0) - rows (3,3) and (4,2) are demoted by the k=11 census - each with shared = 1 and A_x = B_x = 1 at the unique shared sum
